optimizer: Fresh Adam; parent adapter weights retained exactly before first step
selection: Fixed duration; no selection using final answers
evaluation: Base, parent v5 and continued v6 on the same reserved set, greedy no-thinking, numeric cap120/draft450
draftRubric: Valid JSON, all explicit facts and exclusions preserved; no invented scope/conditions; only explicitly open questions. Manual non-blind review with reasons.
gate: Candidate numeric score must be at least both baselines and strict draft coverage must exceed both. This small gate only permits further evaluation, never automatic deployment.
